flipToBack.timing: Table-changed poll restricted to either player's DEPLOY phase
flipToBack.prose: Flip during any deploy phase if Thrawn is at a battleground (any battleground, site or system) AND Thrawn's Art Collection is on table with 2+ cards stacked on it ('two or more artwork cards on table' is coded as 2+ stacked on the found-first-active Collection).

children.req: phase window: either player's deploy phase
card-on-table: Thrawn's Art Collection found active
counter: 2+ cards stacked on the Collection

flipToFront.timing: Two independent table-changed polls, any phase (route A additionally suppressed during battle)
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if (A) Thrawn's Art Collection is on table with zero stacked cards, except during battle; OR (B) Thrawn cannot be spotted on table (any phase, battle or not). Note: if the Collection itself has left the table, route A cannot fire (it requires spotting the Collection); only route B remains.

children.req: counter: any card stacked on the Collection

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back combines: a phase window (deploy phases only, either player's), a presence-spot leaf (Thrawn AT a battleground - the AT relation over the persona, not control/occupy), a card-on-table leaf (Thrawn's Art Collection active), and a stacked-card COUNTER leaf (>= 2 stacked).
'Artwork cards on table' is implemented purely as cards stacked on Thrawn's Art Collection; there is no independent artwork-card filter in the flip law.

Flip-back route A is a counter-at-zero check gated on the Collection still being on table and NOT during battle; route B is a Thrawn-absence check with no battle exception. Losing Thrawn flips back even mid-battle.
No place-out-of-play condition on either side.

Back 'study' trigger requires battle participant Filters.or(Filters.Imperial_leader, Filters.and(Filters.TIE_Defender, Filters.or(Filters.piloted, Filters.hasPermanentPilot, Filters.hasAboard(self, Filters.character)))) and a Collection with at least one stacked card (Card219_001_BACK.java:94-96).
typedIdentities: Filters.Thrawn (persona; flip actor front, absence flips back)
Filters.Thrawns_Art_Collection (the counter host card; setup-required deploy)
Filters.battleground (front flip location class - any battleground, site or system)
Download (both sides): Filters.or(Filters.battleground_system, Filters.and(Filters.site, Filters.deployableToSystem(self, Title.Lothal, null, false, 0)))

Play ban (both sides): Filters.or(Filters.Chiraneau, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Icon.EPISODE_I, Icon.EPISODE_VII), Filters.or(Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility, Icon.PRESENCE)))

Front deploy discounts: Filters.and(Filters.Imperial_starship, Filters.Star_Destroyer) -1 to Filters.not(Filters.Lothal_location); to Filters.Lothal_location via CardMatchesEvaluator(PerStarDestroyerEvaluator(-1), ConstantEvaluator(-3), Filters.Chimaera)
Back study trigger participants: Filters.Imperial_leader, Filters.TIE_Defender (piloted variants)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Lothal system (Card219_001.java:57), Lothal: Advanced Projects Laboratory (64), Lothal: Imperial Complex (71), Thrawn's Art Collection (78).

FRONT and BACK (same GameTextActionId.A_GREAT_TACTICIAN_CREATES_PLANS__DOWNLOAD_LOCATION, once per turn): deploy a battleground system, or a site deployable to Lothal, from Reserve Deck (Card219_001.java:99-119; Card219_001_BACK.java:70-90).

BACK conditional upload: if studied artwork's printed destiny is 3-4, take a card with ability into hand from Reserve Deck (Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility) (Card219_001_BACK.java:121-124, GameTextActionId.THE_RESULT_IS_OFTEN_RESENTMENT__UPLOAD_CARD).
otherObligations: BOTH SIDES: may not play Chiraneau, or your [Episode I]/[Episode VII] cards with ability or [Presence] (front Card219_001.java:90-92; back Card219_001_BACK.java:62-64 - coded as while-active modifier on each side separately, not until-end-of-game).
FRONT: Imperial Star Destroyers deploy -1 to non-Lothal locations; to Lothal locations -1 (Chimaera -3) (Card219_001.java:93-94).

BACK: on battle initiation involving an Imperial leader or piloted TIE Defender, may 'study' one card stacked on Thrawn's Art Collection: printed destiny 0-2 cancels opponent's participants' immunity to attrition for the battle; 3-4 uploads a card with ability; 5+ adds 3 to your total power; studied card then goes to owner's Lost Pile (Card219_001_BACK.java:93-141). NOTE: each study SPENDS one stacked artwork - draining the stack to zero triggers flip-back route A outside battle.

Rando obligations: front - keep Thrawn alive and parked at a battleground during deploy phases while accumulating 2+ stacked artwork; back - protect Thrawn (his loss flips back even during battle) and do not study the stack to zero unless a battle is live (flip-back A is battle-suppressed).
